content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD WK_DATA2D 2-D directional-spectrum wavemaker를 SWAN-to-Boussinesq nesting interface로 추적한 source analysis이다(1-31행). It separates internal Wei-Kirby source and absorbing-generating boundary paths, enumerates file reading and hard-coded ±60-degree culling (33-38행), then derives Nwogu wavenumber/D_gen/Gaussian Cm-Sm/time ramp and Airy-Newton boundary eta/u/v coefficients (40-60행). It identifies path-dependent dispersion, eta-only application, phase inconsistency, random fallback and reference-level velocity (62-79행).
entities: two path differences and reproducibility findings (lines 62-68)

params_defined.name: verification_method
params_defined.default: direct read of wavemaker.F, sources.F and sponge.F

params_defined.name: Phase2D
params_defined.default: optional input phase block; random fallback if absent
params_defined.range: degrees on input, converted to radians

equations.expr: D_gen=2 AMP_WK cos(theta)(omega^2-alpha1 g k^4 h^3)/(omega k rI(1-alpha(kh)^2))
Cm=sum D_gen exp(-beta(x-Xc)^2) cos(rlamda y+phi); Sm=sin
WaveMaker_Mass=sum AA(Cm cos omega t+Sm sin omega t); AA=tanh(pi FreqPeak t/Time_ramp)
Cm_eta=sum Amp cos(k sin(theta)Y+k cos(theta)X); Sm_eta=sin
Cm_u=sum Amp sigma cosh(k Zlev)/sinh(kh) cos(theta) cos(...)

calls: internal path calls CALCULATE_Cm_Sm and sources.F apply (lines 28,30)
boundary path calls CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm then ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC (lines 29,31)
Newton iteration updates k until residual or iteration limit (line 56)
unresolved: internal-source width line defines beta_gen but rI uses beta in both sqrt and exponent (line 46). Unless beta is an explicit alias assigned earlier, this is an identifier mismatch/use-before-assign in the presented formula.

the same line states beta_gen=80/(delta^2 L^2) and width=delta L/2 (line 46). A Gaussian exp(-beta x^2) with that beta has characteristic 1/sqrt(beta)=delta L/sqrt(80), not delta L/2; the width convention is not explained.
wavenumber and D_gen expressions divide by h, alpha1, omega, k, rI and 1-alpha(kh)^2 (lines 43,45), and beta_gen divides by delta^2 L^2 (line 46). Zero/near-singular guards are not shown.

direction culling compares Dire against 60 degrees and Phase2D is explicitly converted degrees-to-radians (lines 36-37), but no direction-angle conversion is shown before cos(theta)/sin(theta) use (lines 45-48,57-58). Direction units at the trigonometric interface are unresolved.
Airy Newton termination allows Iter>1000 in addition to residual tolerance (line 56). The behavior for a nonconverged k at the cap, Fkdif=0, and starting guess are not stated.

components with |dir|>=60 degrees are silently discarded (lines 36,63) with no energy renormalization, warning count, or rejected-energy diagnostic; total incoming SWAN energy therefore becomes path/input-direction dependent.

Cm_u/Sm_u/Cm_v/Sm_v are computed but boundary application forces eta only (line 65), and Phase_Ser is commented out on the boundary while Phase2D is used internally (line 66). These calculated but unused velocity/phase interfaces make the two routes non-equivalent.
phase-less input uses compiler-dependent rand() without seed control (line 67), so identical WaveCompFile input does not define a reproducible run.
